Title: Winter at Greenwich Peninsula (vintage carousel and Market Quarter) – Peninsula Square
ScheduleText: Daily 12:00–21:00, 7 Nov 2026–3 Jan 2027 (hours may vary; 24 Dec shorter, 25 Dec closed per a Visit Greenwich listing)
Description: Christmas market stalls around a central tree and a restored vintage carousel in Peninsula Square, no booking needed.
